papers.title_en: ReaDiT Guidance: Control for Image and Video Generation using Diffusion Transformer Features
papers.authors: Jay Mahajan, Chang Liu, Rauf Makharov, Viraj Shah, Alexander Schwing, Svetlana Lazebnik
papers.evidence: 利用扩散Transformer特征引导深度、姿态与边缘等几何目标
papers.tldr: 现有扩散 Transformer 生成控制多依赖额外适配器或微调，参数开销大且泛化受限。ReaDiT Guidance 提出轻量框架，直接读取单个 DiT 块的内部特征，在测试时按深度、姿态、边缘图等空间目标引导图像与视频生成。由于现代文生视频模型多基于 DiT 骨干，该方法可自然扩展至相机与运动控制，无需重新训练主干。实验表明其效果优于或媲美现有基于特征和现成适配器的方法，且所需参数更少，展现通用可控生成潜力。
papers.abstract_en: We present DiT Readout (ReaDiT) Guidance, a lightweight framework for controlling generation with Diffusion Transformer (DiT) models via their internal feature representations. ReaDiT Guidance uses features from a single DiT block to steer the generative process according to spatial targets - like depth, pose, or edge maps - provided at test time. Furthermore, since modern text-to-video models are largely built on DiT backbones, ReaDiT Guidance naturally extends to video generation, enabling camera and motion control. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves competitive or improved results compared to existing feature-based and off-the-shelf adapter-based approaches while requiring fewer parameters.

papers.title_en: Functional-SLAM: Interaction-Aware Mapping with Online Functional Scene Graphs
papers.authors: Xinggang Hu, Chenyangguang Zhang, Zihan Zhu, Ruida Zhang, Xiangkui Zhang, Xiangyang Ji
papers.evidence: 在线维护功能三维场景图的层级场景建模
papers.tldr: 现有SLAM缺乏细粒度交互所需的功能关系建模，功能3D场景图又依赖离线重建，难支持实时探索。Functional-SLAM首次把功能场景图作为在线SLAM状态递归维护：以锚关键帧几何和功能上下文约束保持节点，用时序多帧证据提交稳定功能边，并以功能拓扑补充视觉回环候选。实验显示它能在线高效构建稳定功能地图，运行时间明显优于离线方法且精度有竞争力，还通过功能拓扑辅助回环提升位姿估计。
papers.abstract_en: Existing SLAM systems lack modeling of the functional relations required for fine-grained robotic interaction. Functional 3D scene graphs can represent relations between objects and interaction elements, but existing methods rely on offline reconstruction, making them inadequate for real-time interaction in real-world exploration. To address this limitation, we propose Functional-SLAM, the first framework that continuously and recursively maintains a functional scene graph as an online SLAM state. The framework combines anchor-keyframe geometry with functional-context constraints for persistent node maintenance, accumulates multi-frame evidence through temporal relations to commit stable functional edges, and supplements visual loop-closure candidates with functional topology in scenes with repetitive appearance or degraded texture. Experiments show that Functional-SLAM efficiently constructs stable functional maps online, substantially improving runtime over offline methods while maintaining highly competitive accuracy. Compared with peer SLAM systems, it further improves pose estimation accuracy through functional-topology-assisted loop closure. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Hbelief1998/Functional-SLAM-CoRL_2026.

papers.title_en: CoordFormer: Give Me Any Coordinates and I Will Give You Labels
papers.authors: Iacopo Curti, Pierluigi Zama Ramirez, Alioscia Petrelli, Luigi Di Stefano
papers.evidence: 坐标解码器以局部交叉注意力融合高分辨率块特征与全局ViT令牌进行分割
papers.tldr: 超高分辨率图像语义分割面临计算开销大、细粒度细节难保留的双重挑战。CoordFormer提出一种基于坐标的语义分割架构，能够在任意空间位置直接预测标签。其Coordinate Decoder将坐标嵌入与高分辨率局部块特征结合，并通过Localized Cross-Attention与ViT基础编码器从下采样图像中提取的全局token进行交互，从而兼顾丰富语义上下文与像素级精度。该设计支持任意分辨率推理，在超高分辨率输入下保持低内存，并可启用语义边缘聚焦策略，将计算集中在边界区域以降低延迟。实验表明，CoordFormer在MaSS13K上达到当前最优，并在DIS5K与KPIs上超过同规模及更高参数方法，验证了其高质量超高分辨率语义分割的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation on very-high-resolution images remains challenging due to the high computational cost and the difficulty of capturing fine-grained details. We propose CoordFormer, a novel coordinate-based architecture for semantic segmentation that predicts labels at arbitrary spatial locations through a Coordinate Decoder equipped with a Localized Cross-Attention mechanism. The decoder combines coordinate embeddings with high-resolution local patch features and interacts with global tokens extracted from a downsampled image processed by a ViT foundation encoder, enabling rich semantic context while preserving pixel-level precision. This design enables flexible inference at arbitrary resolutions while keeping memory low on very-high-resolution inputs, and supports an efficient semantic-edge-focused strategy that concentrates computation along boundaries, maintaining fine-grained accuracy while reducing latency and computational cost. CoordFormer achieves state-of-the-art performance on MaSS13K and outperforms comparably sized and higher-parameter methods on DIS5K and KPIs, demonstrating its effectiveness for high-quality, very-high-resolution semantic segmentation.

papers.title_en: Guiding Image-to-3D Generation with Test-Time Partial Observations
papers.authors: Jerred Chen, Simon Weber, Ronald Clark
papers.evidence: 用占用似然在测试时引导图像到3D生成以提升几何保真
papers.tldr: 仅凭单张RGB图像生成3D资产虽视觉逼真，但几何常仅被观测松散约束，限制高保真应用。本文提出免训练框架，在测试时利用部分几何观测，以基于占据表示的射线一致观测似然引导预训练生成模型。将该方法用于SAM 3D及多视图扩展后，不同可观测程度下的几何保真度与视觉质量均显著提升。无需重训或微调，即可让学习到的生成先验与测试时证据有效互补，提升实用性。
papers.abstract_en: Image-to-3D models can generate visually compelling 3D assets from a single RGB image, but their geometry is often only loosely constrained by the available observations, limiting their use in applications that require geometric fidelity. In many real-world settings, however, partial geometric observations of the object may be available at test time. We introduce a training-free framework for incorporating such evidence into pretrained image-to-3D generative models without retraining or finetuning. To do this, we guide generation using a ray-consistent observation likelihood defined over the model's occupancy representation, combining surface occupancy and free-space evidence. Applied to SAM 3D and its multi-view extension, our approach substantially improves geometric fidelity across different levels of observability, as well as visual quality. Our results demonstrate that pretrained image-to-3D models can effectively integrate partial geometric observations through explicit test-time guidance, complementing their learned generative priors without modifying the underlying model.

papers.title_en: FreeFlow: A Bias-free Hierarchical Transformer for Optical Flow Estimation
papers.authors: Vladislav Bargatin, Alexander Yakovenko, Khaled Abud, Dmitriy Vatolin
papers.evidence: 用于几何视觉任务的分层Transformer
papers.tldr: 现有光流方法依赖相关体积、特征变形和迭代细化等任务特定归纳偏置，虽精度高却限制表达力，并带来复杂流程与额外计算成本。FreeFlow提出不含光流专用组件的层次化Transformer，仅用单次前馈编码器-解码器，融合窗口注意力、移位窗口注意力与低分辨率全局注意力。该设计可随模型容量自然扩展，从小模型到大模型精度持续提升。它在Sintel、KITTI-2015和Spring等基准取得最优结果，且1080p推理内存高效，证明无偏置架构同样可行。
papers.abstract_en: Optical flow methods typically rely on task-specific inductive biases, such as correlation volumes, feature warping, and iterative refinement, among others, to reach high accuracy. While effective, such biases constrain the model to predefined heuristics, which can limit its expressivity and lead to more complex pipelines and additional computational cost. We present FreeFlow, a hierarchical transformer built without any flow-specific components, using instead a single feed-forward encoder--decoder. FreeFlow combines three attention variants: window attention for local processing, shifted-window attention for cross-window information exchange, and a global attention operating at a reduced resolution. The resulting architecture scales naturally with model capacity, enabling a consistent accuracy gain from small to large variants. Despite the absence of standard inductive biases, FreeFlow achieves state-of-the-art results on major benchmarks, including Sintel (0.68/1.48 EPE on Clean/Final), KITTI-2015 (3.23 Fl-all), and Spring (3.192 1px), while remaining memory efficient at 1080p inference.
